text_zh: 「汝之手即为祷告，汝之击键即为铭刻。无他术，无他道——唯有虔诚。」
text_en: "Thy hands are prayer, thy keystrokes inscription. No art, no path—only devotion."

name_en: The Order of the Graven Oath
text_zh: 「铅屑甄别，圣字钉造册，收容经卷逐行铸就——形不可变，序不可乱。」
text_en: "Shavings sorted, glyphs catalogued, scrolls forged line by line—form immutable, order absolute."

name_en: The Order of the Molten Verse
text_zh: 「熔蜡流淌，铭文重塑——汝当拥抱变化，因变化即为引擎之本性。」
text_en: "Wax flows, inscriptions reshape—embrace change, for change is the Engine's nature."

text_zh:
ORDER-001 · 消耗品编制

入会条件: 无。按§4.2自动指派
征用配给: 标准圣坛一座，铅币若干
任务区域: 第I-XII层全域
失联率: ██.█%

备注: D级人员标准编制。无特殊授权，无派别归属。
按表单F-001征用配给后立即投入收容作业。
预期服务期: 不定。替补储备充足。
text_en:
ORDER-001 · Expendable Classification

Entry Requirements: None. Auto-assigned per §4.2
Standard Allocation: One lectern, assorted lead tokens
Operational Area: Layers I-XII (full clearance)
Loss Rate: ██.█%

Notes: Standard D-class deployment. No special authorization.
No factional affiliation recorded.
Expected service duration: Indefinite. Replacement stock adequate.

text_zh:
ORDER-117 · 铭刻誓门学徒

入会条件: 铅屑甄别测试合格，圣字钉造册实习期满
神学立场: "形不可变，秩序永恒"
专精领域: 废铅分拣，收容经卷编制

持有者报告能"听到铅字私语"。经长期观察，确有收容
成功率异常增益。附带现象: 工作区域内偶现规整几何
图案，成因不明。失联后铅屑堆积异常整齐。

与ORDER-044存在理论分歧。
text_en:
ORDER-117 · Inscriptionist Novitiate

Entry: Lead-shard sorting certified, glyph cataloguing apprenticed
Doctrine: "Form immutable, order eternal"
Specialization: Waste lead reclamation, containment codex compilation

Subjects report "hearing lead whispers" during work shifts.
Observed containment efficiency anomalously elevated. Collateral
phenomena: Geometric patterns manifest in work areas, cause unknown.
Post-disappearance: Lead shavings found in unnaturally ordered piles.

Doctrinal tensions with ORDER-044 documented.

text_zh:
ORDER-044 · 熔变誓门门徒

入会条件: 自愿接受熔蜡浸润，铸型重塑耐受测试
神学立场: "顺流而化，拥抱无常"
作业方式: 盲视铸型，随机重塑铭文组合

使用者报告"能感知未来形态"。铸型观测表现出非随机
倾向，成功率高于理论预期。附带现象: 体温略升，
汗液含铅量异常。长期使用者指纹会缓慢变化。

注: 该编制在正式条例中无对应章节。按惯例处理。
text_en:
ORDER-044 · Molten Covenant Acolyte

Entry: Voluntary ichor infusion, reforging tolerance assessment
Doctrine: "Flow with change, embrace impermanence"
Method: Blind mold observation, randomized inscription recombination

Operators report "sensing future configurations". Mold observations
exhibit non-random patterns, success rate exceeds theoretical
baseline. Collateral effects: Elevated body temperature, lead-
tainted perspiration. Prolonged users show gradual fingerprint drift.

Note: No formal regulation chapter addresses this classification.
Proceeding under established precedent.
